sources.title: Effect of 528 Hz Music on the Endocrine System and Autonomic Nervous System
sources.sections_read: Abstract; Introduction frequency definition; Methods 2.1–2.4; opening salivary Results 3.1.
sources.reading_depth: Selected full-text methods/results, no raw-data reanalysis.
sources.provenance: Akimoto et al., primary small exploratory report.
sources.supports: The exposure called 528 Hz was piano music with a changed reference tuning, not an isolated 528 Hz tone. Nine participants and multiple time/biomarker comparisons motivate stronger design.
sources.does_not_support: DNA repair or frequency-specific treatment. Within-condition significance versus non-significance is not itself a significant between-condition difference.
sources.unresolved: Direct condition-by-time contrast, multiplicity, order effects and exact matched audio require investigation.
